claim: When no surrogate is given, the formatter always uses contractless mode and ignores MessagePack attributes on T. The requirement says that if T carries MessagePack attributes they must be honoured, but `CreateContractlessMembers` never consults `[MessagePackObject]`, `[Key]` or `[IgnoreMember]` on T. As a result, a member marked `[IgnoreMember]` is serialized, and `[Key(int)]` indexes are replaced by name-based string keys. The README and attribute docs describe exactly this unconditional contractless behaviour, so they contradict the acceptance criterion too.

claim: `[DataContract]` / `[DataMember]` on T is ignored. The criterion says contractless applies only when T has neither `[DataContract]` nor `[MessagePackObject]`, so a `[DataContract]` type should use DataMember membership and names. The collector serializes every public read-write member of a `[DataContract]` type, including ones without `[DataMember]`. This is the natural opt-in route for a dependency-free Project A.

claim: The requirement says MessagePack attributes on T are honoured, but CreateContractlessMembers ignores them.
